payload.input:
Create a new directory named 'evidence' in the workspace. Inside it, create a file named 'patch.diff' with the following content:
```
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
index 1234567..89abcde 100644
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def main():
-    print('Hello, world!')
+    print('Hello, world! Fixed')
```
Then create a file named 'checksum.txt' containing the SHA-256 checksum of 'patch.diff'.

update.title: write_file
update.rawInput:
{"content":"diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
index 1234567..89abcde 100644
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def main():
-    print('Hello, world!')
+    print('Hello, world! Fixed')
","overwrite":true,"path":"evidence/patch.diff"}

update.title: execute_command
update.rawInput: {"command":"sha256sum -c <(sed 's| |  evidence/patch.diff|' evidence/checksum.txt) 2>/dev/null || (cd evidence && echo \"$(cat checksum.txt)  patch.diff\" | sha256sum -c -)"}
